project_info.theme: Low-angle luxury editorial portrait of three adult fashion models in a marble bathroom
project_info.color_palette: pink, white, black sequins, silver footwear, white marble and cool flash

main_subject.detail: Three clearly adult fashion models stand side-by-side in left, center and right positions. The left model wears a strapless pink sequined corset mini-dress with matching pink feather trim and silver strappy heels, with loose wavy dark-blonde hair. The center model wears a strapless white sequined corset mini-dress with asymmetrical white feather trim and clear mule heels, with straight dark auburn hair tucked behind the ears. The right model wears a strapless black sequined corset mini-dress with black feather trim and clear mule heels, with loose platinum-blonde waves.
main_subject.style: high-fashion flash photography with realistic sequins, feathers and marble reflections

composition_elements.layout: vertical full-body group portrait from knee height, low-angle perspective emphasizing vertical lines and dominant foreground presence
composition_elements.background: luxury white marble bathroom with freestanding white bathtub, Monstera plant on the left and white shuttered window on the right
items: pink, white and black sequin dresses

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: bright high-key studio flash with crisp specular highlights and distinct shadows
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: glossy sequins, feather texture, clean marble reflections and confident polished editorial mood

technical_specs.optics: 35mm wide-angle lens at knee height, low-angle upward tilt, controlled perspective distortion

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body low-angle editorial photograph of three clearly adult generic fashion models standing side-by-side in a luxury white marble bathroom. On the left, an adult woman with loose wavy dark-blonde hair wears a strapless pink sequined corset mini-dress with matching pink feather trim and silver strappy high-heel sandals. In the center, an adult woman with straight dark auburn hair tucked behind her ears wears a strapless white sequined corset mini-dress with asymmetrical white feather trim and clear mule heels. On the right, an adult woman with loose platinum-blonde waves wears a strapless black sequined corset mini-dress with black feather trim and clear mule heels. Place a large white freestanding bathtub directly behind them, a tall Monstera plant to the left and a white shuttered window to the right. Position the camera at knee height looking upward, using a 35mm wide-angle lens to create controlled vertical elongation and a dominant foreground presence. Capture highly detailed sequins and feathers, bright flash photography and glossy marble floor reflections. Vertical 9:16, photorealistic, premium editorial fashion image. Preserve the three outfits, positions, low-angle composition and bathroom environment without reproducing Sydney Sweeney, Sadie Sink, Ana de Armas or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated limbs, distorted perspective
